Key Milestones

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s Directors represent the third and fourth generation of a successful line of authentic Ayurveda practitioners. A family of individual business styles and talents, together they form an award-winning team riding on a wave of international success.

Founder’s Message

“As globalization takes over our world at a rapid pace, it is unsurprising to see an increase in the popularity of alternative health and wellness destinations across the planet. The daily stresses to keep up in this fast-paced world, and the growing lack of faith in allopathic medication has forced people to look elsewhere and explore other natural and harmless forms of treatment for health and rejuvenation.
It was with this vision that my wife and I decided to venture upon what we know best and what our forefathers had known for so long. Over two decades ago, i.e., 1989, we decided to show the world that Ayurvedic treatments coupled with a modern facilities in a peaceful and green setting would create the ideal environment for recovery.
During these last few years, many new resorts and treatment centres have been set up, all claiming to provide “Ayurvedic” treatments. However, most of these treatment centres neglect even the basic principles of Ayurveda and Hospitality. Our aim therefore, was simple - to create awareness of the quality and efficacy of Ayurveda when it is done right.

Our aim was to cut through all economic classes instead of concentrating solely on the premium segment, so that an overall awareness of this great medicinal form could reach the masses as well.
We at the Kairali Group inherently believe that the overall service we provide as hosts is just as important as the Ayurvedic treatments and other facilities at our destinations. It is this standard that drives us to constantly improve our management techniques, and elevate our goals in terms of how we run our centres and resorts. This allows us to manage, operate and promote existing hotels and resorts that share this high standard, regardless of the location. Our mission is and will always be to set the benchmark in standards for both Ayurveda and Hospitality.”

K.V. Ramesh (Chairman & Managing Director)
Kairali Ayurvedic Group

Management Team

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s Directors represent the third and fourth generation of a successful line of authentic Ayurveda practitioners. A family of individual business styles and talents, together they form an award-winning team riding on a wave of international success.

K.V. Ramesh

Chairman & Managing Director

The Managing Director and co-founder of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Ramesh has 40 years of experience in the sphere of Ayurveda and is one of the fore-runner in promoting Ayurveda globally. His involvement to Ayurveda did not simply start from when he first founded the Kairali Ayurvedic Group through a small center in South Delhi, rather as a teenager, helping his father Dr. K.S.V Vasudevan at his office. In addition Mr. Ramesh brings in his management expertise from heading a multinational consortium with close to 250 M$ revenue.

Gita Ramesh

Managing Director

The heart and soul behind the Kairali Group since its inception, Mrs Gita Ramesh is the Joint Managing Director. Her status as a pioneer in the health and travel industry is reflected in her Safari India National Tourism Award of ‘Best Woman Entrepreneur for Promoting Wellness’, 2010. A renowned Ayurvedic chef and scholar, Mrs Gita Ramesh’s contribution to the Kairali Ayurvedic Group has led to the high standards of knowledge and treatments we offer our guests today.

Abhilash K.R.

Director

The eldest in the next generation of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Abhilash’s contribution to the exemplary international growth and continuing marketing success of Kairali is obvious. Having grown up in the centre of a thriving Ayurveda enterprise, like his father before him, his inherited Ayurvedic know-how paired with extensive global business experience makes him the ideal sales and marketing representative for Kairali in the international wellness scene.

Abishek K.R.

Director

“Mr. Abishek belongs from a prominent Ayurvedic family in Kerala, India that is renowned for its great lineage in traditional Ayurvedic treatments and manufacture of Ayurvedic products. He is a Director of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group. Operational and new business setups are his expertise. In a short span of time he has achieved great feats in expanding and escalating Kairali's pharmaceutical, training and franchisee units and strengthening its core businesses. With uniquely global skill set and creative outlook Mr. Abishek has, in last decade, set up and established many successful Ayurvedic spas and treatment centers all across the globe and in India. He specializes in creating, conceptualizing and delivering world class spas customized to objective from concept. This includes setting up a spa in a resort or a hotel, destination or a day spa centres and world class Ayurvedic treatment centers. He has established himself as a well-known personality in the Indian and international Spa Industry and is the perfect blend of technical skill and excellent business sense. Areas of expertise include: business optimisation, excellence in operations and service standards, concept development, brand consistency and corporate strategy.”

A family of individual business styles and talents, together they form an award-winning team riding on a wave of international success. Founder’s Message “As globalization takes over our world at a rapid pace, it is unsurprising to see an increase in the popularity of alternative health and wellness destinations across the planet. The daily stresses to keep up in this fast-paced world, and the growing lack of faith in allopathic medication has forced people to look elsewhere and explore other natural and harmless forms of treatment for health and rejuvenation. It was with this vision that my wife and I decided to venture upon what we know best and what our forefathers had known for so long. Over two decades ago, i.e., 1989, we decided to show the world that Ayurvedic treatments coupled with a modern facilities in a peaceful and green setting would create the ideal environment for recovery. During these last few years, many new resorts and treatment centres have been set up, all claiming to provide “Ayurvedic” treatments. However, most of these treatment centres neglect even the basic principles of Ayurveda and Hospitality. Our aim therefore, was simple - to create awareness of the quality and efficacy of Ayurveda when it is done right. Our aim was to cut through all economic classes instead of concentrating solely on the premium segment, so that an overall awareness of this great medicinal form could reach the masses as well. We at the Kairali Group inherently believe that the overall service we provide as hosts is just as important as the Ayurvedic treatments and other facilities at our destinations. It is this standard that drives us to constantly improve our management techniques, and elevate our goals in terms of how we run our centres and resorts. This allows us to manage, operate and promote existing hotels and resorts that share this high standard, regardless of the location. Our mission is and will always be to set the benchmark in standards for both Ayurveda and Hospitality.” K.V. Ramesh (Chairman & Managing Director) Kairali Ayurvedic Group Management Team Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s Directors represent the third and fourth generation of a successful line of authentic Ayurveda practitioners. A family of individual business styles and talents, together they form an award-winning team riding on a wave of international success. K.V. Ramesh Chairman & Managing Director The Managing Director and co-founder of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Ramesh has 40 years of experience in the sphere of Ayurveda and is one of the fore-runner in promoting Ayurveda globally. His involvement to Ayurveda did not simply start from when he first founded the Kairali Ayurvedic Group through a small center in South Delhi, rather as a teenager, helping his father Dr. K.S.V Vasudevan at his office. In addition Mr. Ramesh brings in his management expertise from heading a multinational consortium with close to 250 M$ revenue. Gita Ramesh Managing Director The heart and soul behind the Kairali Group since its inception, Mrs Gita Ramesh is the Joint Managing Director. Her status as a pioneer in the health and travel industry is reflected in her Safari India National Tourism Award of ‘Best Woman Entrepreneur for Promoting Wellness’, 2010. A renowned Ayurvedic chef and scholar, Mrs Gita Ramesh’s contribution to the Kairali Ayurvedic Group has led to the high standards of knowledge and treatments we offer our guests today. Abhilash K.R. Director The eldest in the next generation of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Abhilash’s contribution to the exemplary international growth and continuing marketing success of Kairali is obvious. Having grown up in the centre of a thriving Ayurveda enterprise, like his father before him, his inherited Ayurvedic know-how paired with extensive global business experience makes him the ideal sales and marketing representative for Kairali in the international wellness scene. Abishek K.R. Director “Mr. Abishek belongs from a prominent Ayurvedic family in Kerala, India that is renowned for its great lineage in traditional Ayurvedic treatments and manufacture of Ayurvedic products. He is a Director of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group. Operational and new business setups are his expertise. In a short span of time he has achieved great feats in expanding and escalating Kairali's pharmaceutical, training and franchisee units and strengthening its core businesses. With uniquely global skill set and creative outlook Mr. Abishek has, in last decade, set up and established many successful Ayurvedic spas and treatment centers all across the globe and in India. He specializes in creating, conceptualizing and delivering world class spas customized to objective from concept. This includes setting up a spa in a resort or a hotel, destination or a day spa centres and world class Ayurvedic treatment centers. He has established himself as a well-known personality in the Indian and international Spa Industry and is the perfect blend of technical skill and excellent business sense. Areas of expertise include: business optimisation, excellence in operations and service standards, concept development, brand consistency and corporate strategy.” Kairali Awards & Accrediations Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village is declared the Winner of Best Luxury Ayurveda Spa for 2020 The Kairali Ayurvedic village has been selected one of the best spots for its first treatment center in Kerala, recognized globally as the origin of Ayurveda. Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s Directors represent the third and fourth generation of a successful line of authentic Ayurveda practitioners. A family of individual business styles and talents, together they form an award-winning team riding on a wave of international success.

K.V. Ramesh
Chairman & Managing Director

The Managing Director and co-founder of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Ramesh belongs to the third generation of a line of renowned Ayurvedic doctors. He assisted his family in their Ayurvedic practice from childhood, and had an early education in the mixing of Ayurvedic medicine, a practice in which his father, Dr. K.S.V. Vasudevan, excelled. Having lived his life in full awareness of the benefits of Ayurveda, Mr. Ramesh maintains a role as a health and business innovator as well as an active philanthropist.

Gita Ramesh
Joint Managing Director

The heart and soul behind the Kairali Group since its inception, Mrs Gita Ramesh is the Joint Managing Director. Her status as a pioneer in the health and travel industry is reflected in her Safari India National Tourism Award of ‘Best Woman Entrepreneur for Promoting Wellness’, 2010. A renowned Ayurvedic chef and scholar, Mrs Gita Ramesh’s contribution to the Kairali Ayurvedic Group has led to the high standards of knowledge and treatments we offer our guests today.

Abhilash K.Ramesh
Director

The eldest in the next generation of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Abhilash’s contribution to the exemplary international growth and continuing marketing success of Kairali is obvious. Having grown up in the centre of a thriving Ayurveda enterprise, like his father before him, his inherited Ayurvedic know-how paired with extensive global business experience makes him the ideal sales and marketing representative for Kairali in the international wellness scene.

Abishek K.Ramesh
Director

“Mr. Abishek belongs from a prominent Ayurvedic family in Kerala, India that is renowned for its great lineage in traditional Ayurvedic treatments and manufacture of Ayurvedic products.
He is a Director of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group. Operational and new business setups are his expertise. In a short span of time he has achieved great feats in expanding and escalating Kairali's pharmaceutical, training and franchisee units and strengthening its core businesses.
With uniquely global skill set and creative outlook Mr. Abishek has, in last decade, set up and established many successful Ayurvedic spas and treatment centers all across the globe and in India. He specializes in creating, conceptualizing and delivering world class spas customized to objective from concept. This includes setting up a spa in a resort or a hotel, destination or a day spa centres and world class Ayurvedic treatment centers.
He has established himself as a well-known personality in the Indian and international Spa Industry and is the perfect blend of technical skill and excellent business sense.
Areas of expertise include: business optimisation, excellence in operations and service standards, concept development, brand consistency and corporate strategy.”

sections.html:
Charitable Concerns

Kairali is always keen to support charitable ventures seeking to help the environment, and less privileged members of the community. As such, we have ongoing involvement with a number of excellent projects.

  • Kairali supports Blue Yonder’s eco-tourism initiative Traveler’s Forest.
  • Prompted by the involvement of their Managing Director, Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Kairali provides support and medical care for blind children, in association with the Hellen Keller Centenary Memorial Model School for the Blind. Kairali Ayurvedic Group adopts a girl every year and provides for her corrective surgery.
  • Kairali supports funding of salaries of teachers for Jan Saranam, a charitable trust.

Product Quality

Kairali is dedicated towards enhancing the good name of Ayurveda and follows the strictest parameters in all its product development and treatment practices.

Our manufacturing facilities are GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) certified by the Government of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka & Kerala, and our ingredients of the highest quality.
Our lives are complimentary to social norms. People who are active in social life are always admirable because of the dedication and contribution for the greater humanitarian benefit.

Local Outreach

Kerala is our home and roots; without its ancient wisdom our success would not have been possible. We firmly believe that we should maintain our ties with the local community and be sure to give much more than we take from them. Our charitable outreach programs serve a range of vital needs in the surrounding population.

  • Kairali Ayurvedic Group provides agricultural land to local farmers in economic difficulty. We also purchase or facilitate the sale of any surplus grain on MSP (minimum support price)
  • We work in partnership with the ‘Hope’ foundation to provide skilled training to local adults, with a special focus on bringing young women economic independence.
  • We donate to local communities around Palakkad, and give financial support and equipment to Chitoor village hospital, as well as a local school in Kodumbu Village.
Working as a team with immense hard work and cooperation brings harmony and success to the organization that in the long run benfits the society as well.

Organic Business Practices

Our strong concern for the environment informs every area of our business. We are firm believers in sustainable practices and use these to sustain our organic herb farm in Kerala. We employ a vermiculture system at The Ayurvedic Healing Village to recycle all our organic waste for compost, which is then used to enrich the soil of our organic herb farm. We recently installed a waste treatment and recycling plant, to ensure maximum sustainability at our Kerala centre. We use CFL lights and state-of-the-art power generators to cut our carbon footprint by over 40%. sections.html:
Kairali Ayurvedic Group believes that successful businesses are built on strong relationships. We continually value, respect, trust and nurture our franchisees and distributors because they are a vital part of our business' future; the partners we require to expand and spread the concept of traditional holistic health around the globe.

Four generations of Ayurveda expertise have given Kairali a leading advantage and a strong standing in India's health industry. Over the years we have effectively merged the traditional Ayurveda techniques with modern concepts and this has led to our successful migration internationally. We uphold the authentic practice that has time and again proven its efficacy over the centuries, and at the same time continually conduct cutting-edge research in order to maximize the potential and the potency of Ayurvedic Medicine for its use in the modern world scenario.

We offer entrepreneurs the opportunity to establish their own Kairali spa and join the expanding group of franchises now spread over countries worldwide and three continents. Existing hotels and spas are invited to contact us for Management and Consultancy services to renovate their spa design and branding or improve and expand their range of therapies.

Leaders in the International Spa Industry

This is the perfect time for international growth and expansion in the spa business. The twenty-first century is witnessing a tremendous escalation of Indian spa centres globally, the spa industry's most trusted critics claim that India's spa industry is now at the international forefront and are predicting that Ayurveda the model of natural ancient health care is set for huge popularity.

According to ASSOCHAM, the Indian herbal industry is likely to double from Rs.7, 500 crores to Rs.15, 000 crores by 2015. Kairali presents a promising opportunity for those with an interest in India's Ayurvedic spa industry as it has established itself as one of the most trusted Ayurvedic brands globally.

Over the years India is known to give high quality Ayurvedic products to the world. The rapid international spread of Indian wellness practices is matched domestically, where the spa industry is growing at a CAGR rate of 20% and expected to reach a value of INR 875 billion by 2015. As holders of Green Leaf Certification, Kairali Ayurvedic Group's Treatment Centres, spas and resorts have already established itself as an eminent provider of the highest quality of wellness services and holistic health care in India.

Our Ayurveda profile is well known in the India’s hospitality world. And our signature retreat The Ayurvedic Healing Village stands as a testament to what traditional, intuitive design can achieve. Already named one of the 'Top Ten Wellness Destinations in Asia' by National Geographic Traveller magazine, the outstanding success of The Ayurvedic Healing Village led to the expansion of Kairali's Hospitality division, and the establishment of our now significant voice in Hotel Management and Consultancy.

Our Ayurveda treatments, therapies and GMP3 -approved products have a reputation of providing the highest standard of natural health care and beauty benefits. And with this authentication Kairali is all set for unlimited international growth. Everything that Kairali has achieved so far stands as a testimony to its winning business formula, consisting of authenticity, effective partnerships and customer satisfaction.

A Shift in International Tourism

The world is rapidly shifting towards a new understanding of health and that is “wellness”. Wellness is an active process of becoming aware of and making choices towards a healthy and fulfilling lifestyle. It is much more than just being free from disease.

The need for a harmonious natural lifestyle goes well beyond all geographical boundaries. And this can be well understood by the unending proliferation of Yoga around the world. As Yoga's complementary health system, it is understandable that Ayurveda too is now following the regime. Yoga and Ayurveda are not merely two separate but related healing disciplines of India. Each has its exclusive place and purpose, but both overlaps into the other on various levels. Ayurveda is beneficial if you are following the path of yoga. Practice of these two incredible healing methods can offer you the true meaning of wellness.

In the last decade the concept of global tourism has gone through a phenomenal change. The consumers are demanding much more in terms of hospitality and wellness. More hotels and resorts are now branding (and rebranding) around expanded wellness offerings. The spa and wellness industry have advanced exceedingly and with the vast choice now available, it is clear that intelligent customers seek a system of health and lifestyle that will help them endorse permanent changes in their life. As a comprehensive science and philosophy of health, there is no system better placed than Ayurveda to introduce a complete wellness and holistic health to one’s lifestyle.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group is dedicated to offering our customers something more than medicine, therapy, Yoga, detox or beauty treatments. We offer full lifestyle coaching, education and support, giving them all the tools they need to permanently enact change when they return home.

Why Kairali?

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group provides full support and resources to hoteliers and entrepreneurs who choose to establish a franchise with us. Your success is our success, and we believe that the bonds between partners should remain strong and respectful to guarantee mutual growth.

A Trusted Brand

Kairali has a robust reputation in India as a luxury therapeutic brand. And this reputation has already extended around the world, and the mark we have made on the international travel industry can be seen in our long list of awards and accolades. As a franchisee partner of Kairali, you can be assured that you shall be obtaining the finest and the best products and opportunities from us, as our businesses grow together.

Spa and Hotel Development

Our partners are unique to us, and every relationship we build is exclusive and special. Some entrepreneurs we deal with are new to the wellbeing industry and choose to take advantage of the full support that we offer, while those with more experience in the hotel and spa business may choose to utilise our authentic Ayurvedic products and treatments, while managing their own operations.

Spa and Hotel Design

Kairali's signature retreat centre, The Ayurvedic Healing Village, stands as a brilliant example of what can be created when you perfectly blend a traditional approach with the best of modern holistic luxury. We can bring a similarly rich environment to the setting and designing of your new spa or profitable innovations to your existing hospitality business.

Marketing support

We have an excellent marketing and communications team and use our international travel and spa expertise for the benefit of your expanding franchise. We are keen to equip our partners with all the industry know-how we have accumulated in our eight decades of holistic health practice and hospitality.

Staff Training

Kairali provides on-going staff training at our centres in India. We are always able to source outstanding Ayurvedic doctors, teachers and therapists to fulfil your staffing needs.

Products

Kairali Spa Franchises are able to stock their choice of over a hundred Kairali products. Your every retail need can be satisfied by our health and beauty product range, including Ayurvedic Medicine, our own patented Ayurvedic Remedies, Skin Care, Body Products and Ayurvedic Spa Equipment.

Technical support

You may wish to make use of Kairali's spa software, in order to instantly co-ordinate your business processes. We offer a software solution that enables the easy management of your business processes and bookings, as well as on-going technical support for our users.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s Hotel and Spa Management Consultancy services is one of the most flourishing assets that help to build new hotels and spas with professional guidance and mentorship. Those who dream of formalizing an institution that not only delivers Ayurvedic treatments and therapies but that which fosters to the all-round propagation of the Ayurvedic principles, then Kairali’s Hotel and Spa Management Consultancy is the right choice.

  • We offer training to improve the hospitality services;
  • Therapist training modules;
  • Spa franchise opportunities;
  • Operational management
  • Marketing strategies;
  • ROS Financial Planning

Our spa consulting company is among the best spa consultant in India that provides able insights and contributions for a modern yet authentic perspective to their business strategies. Kairali’s Hotel and Spa Management Services are the natural outcome of a business practice based on partnerships and the sharing of mutual goals.

The Ayurvedic Healing Village, with its excellent facility and expert therapists at the health farm have motivated and encouraged many to lead a life naturally. The hotel and spa industry of Kairali have rather made the name of the group reach the sky with flying colors.

Hospitality Consultancy by Kairali

The growth and development that Kairali Ayurvedic Group has witnessed from the time of its establishment is manifold. The experience and excellence in delivering the best hospitality service and also the functioning of well-structured Ayurvedic centers at different locations, has made them confident and strong to withhold the sanctity of Ayurveda.

The hotel and spa development policies and strategies that Mr. Abhilash K. Ramesh (Executive Director of Kairali Ayurvedic Group) follows has made the Group stand proudly as the best Ayurveda wellness group by various notable national and international forums. His managerial and operational skills gave the world ‘Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village’, which is one of the best wellness destinations in Asia. The traditional Ayurvedic resort is perfectly integrated with nature’s best surroundings and this architectural design is an epitome of the Group’s achievements. It speaks about their hotel and spa development excellencies that is lauded with world’s best luxury stays amidst nature.

The Ayurvedic Healing Village mergers a traditional approach with the best of modern holistic luxury. We can bring a similarly rich environment to your new spa or transform the therapies and design from your existing one. Experience the journey with us and let us make the world a complete heaven.

A long lineage of Ayurvedic expertise has given Kairali a significant standing in the healthcare & spa industry.

Our traditional knowledge paired with a modern mindset is the reason that we are one of the few Ayurvedic brands to have successfully migrated abroad. We maintain authentic practices that have worked for centuries, while conducting cutting-edge research in order to maximize the potential of Ayurvedic Medicine for use in the modern world.

International Expansion

The notable success of our Ayurvedic Healing Village, established in the year 1999, has led to an increased demand for both domestic and international partnerships with Kairali. Our signature resort made a strong mark on the hospitality and travel industry, both at home and abroad, as can be seen in our long list of awards and accolades. Since this time we have entered mutually beneficial relationships with spa franchisees over three continents, and maintain numerous partnerships and external consultancy work in India.

Partnerships and investment means tons of trust, responsibility and mutual bonding to share and experience every profit and loss of the concerned company. It connotes to the agreement of every dimension of the company and requires the partners to be compatible, honest and equally dedicated towards the project.

Opportunities for investment

With continuing international expansion and new ventures in Ayurveda education and yoga retreats, Kairali represents a leading choice for investment.

The spa industry’s most trusted commentators make it clear in their prediction of wellness trends for 2013 that the top three factors in the travel industry are now; health destinations, experience in nature, and authentic, ancient healing practices, most particularly Ayurveda. It is clear that there can be no better time to invest in the fortunes of this growing holistic therapy as it migrates across the globe. Kairali Ayurvedic Group is at the forefront of considerable expansion, and welcomes contact from potential partners and investors who wish to benefit from their rising profile in the hospitality and travel industry.

sections.html:
Access to Individual Profiles

We respect our visitors' privacy and maintain their profile information on a secured server. Personally identifiable information can be accessed and updated by the member. KAIRALI will not use our visitor's confidential information for purposes, which are not disclosed to or authorized by the visitor. Visitors have the opportunity to review the information they provide and update it at any time.

Occasionally, information that a visitor requests to be removed will be retained in certain files in order to properly resolve disputes or to troubleshoot problems. In addition, information is never completely removed from our databases due to technical and legal constraints, including stored "back up" systems. Therefore, visitors should not expect that all of their personally identifiable information will be completely removed from our databases in response to their request.

Data collected by KAIRALI is an asset. It is possible that KAIRALI, its subsidiaries, affiliates, joint venture companies, or any combination of the foregoing could merge with or be acquired by another legal entity. In such event, visitors should expect that KAIRALI may share some or all of the data collected from its visitors with such other entity; provided that such other entity will be notified of the practices, which apply to personally identifiable information under KAIRALI's applicable privacy policy.

Questions or comments about KAIRALI or about our privacy policy should be directed as follows:

Email: info@kairali.com
Phone: +91-9555156156

Address: Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd.
130 Andheria Modh, Mehrauli
New Delhi - 110030.

Cookies and Invisible Pixels

A cookie is a very small text file that is sent to a visitor's browser from a web server and stored on the visitor's computer hard drive. It assigns the computer with a unique identifier. It is essentially the visitor's identification card when she/he returns to the KAIRALI site. Cookies save visitors time because they help us to provide the visitor a customized experience without having to remind us of his/her preferences each time she/he returns to our web pages. KAIRALI cookies cannot damage visitors’ files, nor can they read information from the visitor's hard drive.

Cookies help us provide our visitors with a personalized online experience in the following ways:

  • They remember visitor names and passwords for future visits so log-in is easier and faster.
  • They ensure visitors are provided with the appropriate frames and content.
  • They ensure visitors obtain the information requested.
  • They help us deliver communications that are relevant and targeted to our visitors' interest.

KAIRALI cookies do not follow visitors when traveling on the INTERNET after leaving KAIRALI websites. We track the usage of our websites in order to modify it according to our visitors' need. We pay attention to what information is requested and attempt to make it easier to find such information in the future.

If visitors do not want the benefits of these cookies they can set their browser to reject the cookies. Visitors should consult the instructions for their particular browser on how to do this. However, visitors should understand that rejecting cookies might affect their ability to perform certain transactions on our websites and our ability to recognize their browser from one visit to the next.

KAIRALI also uses invisible pixels, sometimes called web beacons to count how many people visit certain web pages. Information collected from invisible pixels is used and reported in the aggregate without personally identifiably information. KAIRALI may use this information to improve marketing programs and content.

Questions or comments about KAIRALI or about our privacy policy should be directed as follows:

Email: info@kairali.com
Phone: +91-9555156156

Address: Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd.
130 Andheria Modh, Mehrauli
New Delhi - 110030.

Email

From time to time, KAIRALI asks visitors for their email address in order to provide relevant information such as reservation confirmation and offers. Email addresses may be joined with other information provided at our website and may also be augmented with other data sources. By providing their email addresses to us, visitors may receive email. Visitors will always have the ability to accept or decline email communications from KAIRALI.

Email communications is sent only to people who have consented to receive email from KAIRALI or by our carefully selected third parties. At the time of email capture, KAIRALI will advise the visitor that we will use the email address for service and product information, as well as marketing and promotional communications. At any time a visitor may opt-out of receiving email communication by following the directions posted in every email, or by contacting a KAIRALI customer service representative to opt out of email communication.

Visitors may receive periodic offers and information from KAIRALI about our products and services, as well as offers and information from KAIRALI carefully selected marketing partners. Visitors may also receive offers and information directly from these selected third parties. Visitors who do not want to receive marketing information from KAIRALI and/or these third parties in the future, have the option to contact us in order to decline such communication.

Once the visitor has opted out, they can choose to opt-in again by changing their profile online or by contacting us in any way.

In cases when a visitor voluntarily provides personal information in response to an email (a survey or a purchase, for example) KAIRALI (or a third party engaged by KAIRALI) will inform the visitor how this information will be used. For example, information may be used so visitor can receive goods, services or information that was requested. KAIRALI may also use this information in aggregate form to get a better understanding of the type of individuals responding to specific offers.

Questions or comments about KAIRALI or about our privacy policy should be directed as follows:

Email: info@kairali.com
Phone: +91-9555156156

Address: Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd.
130 Andheria Modh, Mehrauli
New Delhi - 110030.

sections.html:
Security Policy

KAIRALI Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd.’s (KAIRALI) mission is to consistently exceed our visitors' expectations in terms of the products and services we provide by creating a customized experience for each visitor. KAIRALI collects information about our visitors so that we can provide an experience that is tailored to their preferences. Since the privacy of our visitors is of paramount importance to KAIRALI, we wish to protect it and maintain the trust of our visitors while collecting the information necessary to do this. KAIRALI is fully committed to providing information about the collection and use of personal information furnished by or collected from visitors while using our website, products and services. Below is an explanation of the information we collect, how we use it, and why the use of this information will benefit our visitors' experience.

We respect our visitors' privacy. Personally identifiable information can be accessed and updated by our members during and after the registration process. Security is provided concerning credit card information, names, addresses, email addresses and any other personal information that visitors may provide within Reservation, Enquiry and Members portions of our websites. Although "guaranteed security" does not exist either on or off the Internet, we safeguard our visitors' personally identifiable information by using industry standard practices. Currently, our websites utilize a variety of different security measures designed to protect personally identifiable information from unauthorized access by users both inside and outside KAIRALI.

Third party websites that are accessed through links on our websites have separate privacy and data collection practices, and security measures. We have no responsibility or liability for the practices, policies and security measures, implemented by third parties on their websites. We encourage you to contact them to ask questions about their privacy practices, policies and security measures before disclosing personal information.

Questions or comments about KAIRALI or about our privacy policy should be directed as follows:

Email: info@kairali.com
Phone: +91-9555156156

Address: Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd.
130 Andheria Modh, Mehrauli
New Delhi - 110030.

Credit Card information

In the course of doing business, we transmit credit card clearing information to a third party service provider for the purposes of charging or refunding credit cards of our guests. Information transferred during this business operation is transmitted via CC AVENUE provided credit and debit card processing equipment, using a secure link employing industry-standard secure protocols, and does not transmit any individual personal information other than credit card number, such information as is required to verify the validity of the credit card number, and the transaction amount.

Phone: +91-9555156156

Address: Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd.

New Delhi - 110030.

• 2018 AEPTA Lady's Cup Honoured with Kairali Gifts and Vouchers

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group, a 100-year-old Ayurvedic company was the gifting partner of the AEPTA Lady's Cup, 2018 and encouraged the participants and the winners with its gifts and vouchers

    The Lady's Golf Cup, 2018


    This year, the Lady's Golf Cup was held in New Delhi at the Army Golf Course AEPTA, New Delhi. This event was held from the 17th of December to 20th of December, 2018. There were 120 participants in total. It was indeed a wonderful event with all women actively participating in the event.

    It was a delightful moment to see the presence of women empowerment in this championship. Kairali Ayurvedic Group during this event was the gifting partner who delivered their authentic and natural products as a token of love and appreciation. There were different categories in the tournament which were of different ranges. Following are the categories in which the event was distributed:

    Category 1:

    Participation Gift to all participants - Small hamper with essential oil and Herbal Tea.

    Category 2:

    18 Hole Winner - 3 Nights 4 Days Voucher and Gift Hamper of Kairali Ayurvedic Products

    Category 3:

    18 Hole Runner Up - 3 Nights 4 Days Voucher and Gift Hamper of Kairali Ayurvedic Products

    Category 4:

    Post Play to all Participants - 3 minutes Shoulder and Foot Massage

    Indeed this event was a refreshing and an energetic one with Kairali supporting the fun and frolic of those enjoyable moments.

    http://www.whyayurveda.org/events/2018/12/22/2018-aepta-ladys-cup-honoured-with-kairali-gifts-and-vouchers.aspx

    Posted By Abishek Ramesh posted on Sat 22 Dec 2018 at 02:21 PM

  • Kairali Ayurvedic Group-A Major Contributor in the E3 Golf Tournament, 2018

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group was a gifting partner at the E3 Golf Tournament which was held on15th of December 2018 to promote a cause. Various gifts and vouchers were delivered to the winners of the event.

    Gold for a Cause


    "Putting Smiles Golf Tournament"     is a signature Corporate Charity Golf Tournament organized by E3 Integrated. E3 Integrated is an event management company that organizes corporate events and various other social events and promotions. It is high time that we contribute our part for bringing a smile on other's face. We do each and every deed keeping ourselves into focus. How much of the time do we spend in making others' lives easy and comfortable? "Putting Smiles Golf Tournament" was an initiative to make the world a better place to live in for a better tomorrow.

    It was an event where all participants and groups came up together for a social cause related to the development of the underprivileged girl child. The main motive of organizing this event was to support a cause with the help of the eminent participants and to provide a platform to communicate and strengthen their corporate relationships. Golf as a sport has carved its niche and has speedily gained popularity amongst the best of the best, the people who are the real decision makers and can contribute to society especially to the abandoned girl child who is deprived of education and the basic necessities of life.

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group, a 100-year-old Ayurvedic Company, formed under the aegis of renowned disciplinarians and experts established an institution where Ayurveda provides all the solutions to the health-related queries. Speaking about this event, Kairali had made its contribution in promoting a better tomorrow by making people aware of Ayurveda. It was a gifting partner where it had delivered its Ayurvedic products and services to all the winners of the tournament. There were different categories of the tournament and for each category, there were different gifts and vouchers from Kairali. Following are the deliverables from Kairali-

    Category 1: Straight Drive - Abhyangam Therapy Vouchers for Gurgaon Center

    Category 2: Close to the Pin - Abhyangam Therapy Vouchers for Gurgaon Center

    Category 3: 18 Hole Winner - 3 Nights 4 Days Voucher & Gift Hamper from Kairali Ayurvedic Products

    Category 4: 18 Hole Runner Up - 3 Nights 4 Days Voucher & Gift Hamper from Kairali Ayurvedic Products

    Category 5: Participation Gift - Small hamper with Essential Oil and Herbal Tea

    Let us unite together and make this world a beautiful home with fine health and fortune.

    http://www.whyayurveda.org/events/2018/12/17/kairali-ayurvedic-group-a-major-contributor-in-the-e3-golf-tournament-2018.aspx

    Posted By Abishek Ramesh posted on Mon 17 Dec 2018 at 02:07 PM

  • Best Ayurvedic Hospital and Ayurvedic Centre by Safari India, 2018 goes to Kairali Ayurvedic Group

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group, once again wins the Best Ayurvedic Centre and Ayurvedic Centre by Safari India, 2018. Its extra-ordinary hospitality services and Ayurvedic treatment facilities have left Kairali with such notable awards.

    Ayurveda is an ancient form of medical science that caters to the well-being of the overall development of the mind, body and soul. The ancient teachings and principles have led to the creation of a centenarian Ayurvedic brand name known as Kairali Ayurvedic Group. This Company is considered to be the pioneer in preaching the true essence of Ayurveda.

    Contributions and Appreciations:

Partnerships & Investment

A long lineage of Ayurvedic expertise has given Kairali a significant standing in India’s spa industry.

Our traditional knowledge paired with a modern mindset is the reason that we are one of the few Ayurvedic brands to have successfully migrated abroad. We maintain authentic practices that have worked for centuries, while also conducting cutting-edge research in order to maximize the potential of Ayurvedic Medicine for use in the modern world.

Read more

Management Team

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s Directors represent the third and fourth generation of a successful lineage of authentic Ayurveda practitioners.

A family of individual and innovative business styles and talents, together form an award-winning team riding on a wave of international success.

Read more

Kairali Group Founder’s Message

“As globalization takes over our world at a rapid pace, it is unsurprising to see an increase in the popularity of alternative health and wellness destinations across the planet.

The daily stresses to keep up in this fast-paced world, and the growing lack of faith in allopathic medication has forced people to look elsewhere and explore other forms of treatment for health and rejuvenation.

Read more

Kairali's Awards & Accreditations

Kairali rightly deserves its accolades that it achieves for its hard-work every day and night.

Ancient wisdom blended perfectly with modern technology is a unique fusion that is served and offered to the guests who visit Kairali- The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala. People reach the holistic resort to experience and enjoy Ayurveda straight from the ancient text, Yoga and Meditation- inherited directly from our ancient sages in the lap of nature, far away from the immutable cacophony of the world.

Read more

Mission and Vision

Kairali Ayurvedic Group encourages a comprehensive approach to health, which understands the individual as a complex combination of elements capable of being brought into harmony.

We are committed to enhance positivity and wellbeing in individuals, the environment and the global community.

Read more

banner.rest:
Welcome to the World of Ayurveda

Nestling at the foot of the gigantic and mystical Western Ghats, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village is situated at Kodumbu in Palakkad District of Kerala. It is set amidst 50 acres of lush greenery and is a unique paradise blending the comfort of a 5-star holiday with total health orientation.

Exclusive & Invividual Villas are offered to the guests

The retreat has 30 exclusive villas confronting to “VAASTU SHASTRA”, each having a distinctive design on EXTERIOR & INTERIOR with name of each BIRTH STAR, Blending its surroundings with herbs and trees which have immense curative & restorative powers. The surroundings can be best described as a 'RETURN TO NATURE'.

Luxurious Royal Villa

A Royal Villa is an accommodation that takes you into a real regal life-style where the interiors, facilities & amenities make you feel like a true Royal.

Interior of Royal Villa

Considering its professionally designed interiors, quality construction, high-class facilities & comfort-laden amenities, the Royal Villa comes at a surprisingly affordable price.

Exterior of Maharaja Suite surrounded by Water Stream

Maharaja in English means “Emperor”. So, as the name itself suggests it is the Villa of supreme standard. It goes just a notch above the Royal Villa. If you felt like a Royal in a Royal Villa, you will feel like an Emperor here. It has two separate rooms (1 Bed Room & 1 Living Room). It is located very conveniently to all the resorts facilities.

Interior of Maharaja Suite's Bed Room

The Bedroom with King-size beds truly built with luxury in mind and every little detail from the bed covers to the colors of the room.

Exclusive Ayurvedic Center

We have a separate Ayurvedic Treatment centre for Male and Female Clients each having 5 treatment rooms. The treatment centre has Trained & Experienced Male & Female Ayurveda Therapists

Entertainment Facilities

For the guests love playing Billards or Pool, a Billard Table has been installed at the property.

Business Facilities

A dedecated confernece room for Corporates meetings, Conferneces & Seminars is offered at a very nominal price. The room has the capacity of 80 people at a time.

Modern Day fitness facilities alongwith Authentic Ayurveda

For the fitness freaks, we have a Gymnasium with modern state of art equipments such as Treadmill, Electronic Cycle etc.

Updated Library

For the guests who wish to spend their free time with books, we have a Library with latest Books & Magazines

Swimming Pool for People love to play with water / Swimming

A clean & Hygenic swimming pool with modern day facilites is available for all the guests at the retreat irrespective of their accommodation category.

Organic Cultivation of Vegetable & Fruits

We have an Organic Farm where we cultivate vegetable and fruits organically for the good health of our guests.

Restaurant in the service of the guests

We have two restaurants at the property via. Ottapalam & White Lily. Both are fully hygenic & clean. We service pure & fresh vegetarian food at these restaurants.

Dedicated Yoga & Meditation Centre

Yoga session for an hour everyday Morning & Meditation for an hour everyday evening is offered to our guests at an exclusive & dedecated Yoga Centre.

• Kairali donates foodgrains to the migrant workers

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group believes in contributing to the greater good of the society. And to this end, the company has made a substantial donation by distributing food grains to migrant workers during this lockdown.

    Founded over a century ago, Kairali Ayurvedic Group has always been synonymous with high quality and best-in-class service. While the founders and the present leaders have always had a firm belief in offering our services to the needy and give back to the society whenever possible, it was in the testing times of Covid-19, that this belief has permeated to all the employees.

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group made a generous donation of food grains to stranded migrants during this lockdown after their plight was noticed by our senior management. While the whole country was reeling under the side-effects of Covid-19 and the lockdown, the migrants and day-to-day labourers were the hardest hit. Right from being unable to get one meal a day to walking back home on empty stomachs, the migrants faced a survival issue, to say the least.

    Keeping true to our sense of righteousness and trying our best to fulfil our commitment towards society as a responsible brand, we decided to donate food grains to minimize their plight. Taking this thought forward, our CSR team took up the task with a determined zeal and chalked out a plan in record time. And soon, we were ready to take action.

    We tied up with other NGOs and local heroes and sheroes, and started donating sacks of food grains to the migrants. We made sure to pack in a healthy bunch of rice, daal and other basic pulses to pack in a nutritious dietary meal for the migrants who were either on their way to their ancestral village or were finding it difficult to survive without day-to-day earnings.

    At the end of our CSR activity thousands of migrants were fed and we had the satisfaction of having been able to contribute towards society in these difficult times. We hope to keep on improving our services and do our best towards holistic societal improvement.

    Want to know more about us? visit www.kairali.com

    Want to know more about products and services? visit www.kairaliproducts.in

    http://www.whyayurveda.org/csr/2020/08/27/kairali-donates-foodgrains-to-the-migrant-workers.aspx

  • Kairali Ayurvedic Group comes forward to support the Government Institutions

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group, introduces an Instant Hand Sanitizer that effectively kills 99.99% bacteria and germs from hands that is now proudly associated with the Government organizations for supplying hand sanitizers

    Keeping in view that hand sanitizers are being available at great or at exorbitant prices, the Government has declared these items as essential commodities.

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group, 100 year old Ayurvedic brand introduces a new age Instant Kairali Hand Sanitizer that helps cleans dirty and contaminated hands. Fortunately, Kairali hand sanitizers have a perfect solution for all your problems. The demand of sanitizers is increasing day by day and in order to maintain demand supply some of the actions were taken by the Government immediately.

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group is proud to be associated with various Government organizations such as Indian Red Cross Society and Karnataka State Labour Institute for supplying them hand sanitizers to protect the vulnerable people and communities from COVID-19. To supplement the efforts of the Government, Indian Red cross society and Karnataka state labor institute has mobilized essential supplies that include Kairali Hand Sanitizers.     After days of work, one should always have light dinner as compared to lunch and take warm water along with food. Ayurveda recommends avoiding curd at night.

    Ritucharya- This seasonal regimen is the preventive aspect that can be achieved by a change in a diet and in a modern lifestyle. These changes improve the strength and complexion of the person.

These lifestyle issues in the IT sector should be curbed and improved to make it possible for the companies as well as employees to grow. Kairali makes an attempt through Ayurveda to make lives better and productive.

    Health that needs to be replaced with 'Good Health'

    We all know how our lives are becoming stressful day by day. Each and every activity of ours is making us prone to various health issues that need serious attention and care. A piece of recent news by WION has given the world some shocking results relating to the loss of productivity that has hit the IT sector. We are quite aware of the fact that stress and other unwanted pressures are harmful to the body. Yet we procrastinate our daily requirements and continue to lead a life amidst chaos and confusion.

    A news clip on WION News had taken India through a reality check wherein it has shown how the IT sector in Bengaluru is leading to a huge productivity loss and when these statistics were revealed in terms of quantity, everyone was blown away. It revealed that the IT sector is losing 24,000 crores which is equivalent to 3.5 billion dollars annually due to the bad lifestyle choices that they have adopted. Stress and sedentary lifestyle have often been regarded as the major contributors to a deteriorating health condition. And this condition does not only remain limited to physical instability but also the overall productivity of an individual.

    In order to quantify the monetary loss caused by lifestyle-related problems in the IT sector in Bengaluru, a city-based consulting firm carried out a survey across 10 IT firms. According to the study, the 50 million dollar IT hub of Bengaluru is suffering from a performance drop and the professionals are making an effort to bring up their living conditions. Physical inactivity and poor emotional health are the major contributors for 50% of the productivity loss. It has also been found that employees within the age bar of 30-40 are found to count to 42% of productivity loss and those coming under 20-30 years counts to 30% of the productivity loss with poor diet.

    The respondents who were being surveyed by the Consulting firm were analysed on five different parameters namely-

    1. Physical inactivity

    2. Emotional and mental health

    3. Physical health

    4. Improper diet and

    5. Substance Abuse

    These parameters revealed the fact that Physical inactivity sums up to 25% of productivity loss, emotional and mental health leads to 23%, Physical health leads to 21%, poor diet leads to 18% and substance abuse leads to 13% of the productive loss. Encouraging employees to opt for certain physical activities or creating awareness about the same is likely to bring more lifestyle changes in society. It is a win-win situation for both the parties as good health would lead to a more progressive and developed corporate structure.

    Taking into consideration the contemporary lifestyle issues that lead to obesity and other health problems, Kairali Ayurvedic Group has come up with some natural alternatives to combat the struggling issues. Ayurvedic treatments and therapies to release stress and obesity, Yoga and Meditation for health and wellness and a strict Ayurvedic diet regimen are provided by Kairali to let people understand the need for a healthy mind and body to continue with a long-lasting and fit life. The true essence of Ayurveda can be sensed at Kairali due to which a completely natural and a holistic life can be enjoyed without incurring any loss at a personal as well as at a professional level.

After days of work, one should always have light dinner as compared to lunch and take warm water along with food. Ayurveda recommends avoiding curd at night. Ritucharya- This seasonal regimen is the preventive aspect that can be achieved by a change in a diet and in a modern lifestyle. These changes improve the strength and complexion of the person. Achara Rasayana- As per Ayurveda, this mental regimen is said to be an important part of preventive medicine that helps to have good control over the mind. These lifestyle issues in the IT sector should be curbed and improved to make it possible for the companies as well as employees to grow. Kairali makes an attempt through Ayurveda to make lives better and productive. Health that needs to be replaced with 'Good Health' We all know how our lives are becoming stressful day by day. Each and every activity of ours is making us prone to various health issues that need serious attention and care. A piece of recent news by WION has given the world some shocking results relating to the loss of productivity that has hit the IT sector. We are quite aware of the fact that stress and other unwanted pressures are harmful to the body. Yet we procrastinate our daily requirements and continue to lead a life amidst chaos and confusion. A news clip on WION News had taken India through a reality check wherein it has shown how the IT sector in Bengaluru is leading to a huge productivity loss and when these statistics were revealed in terms of quantity, everyone was blown away. It revealed that the IT sector is losing 24,000 crores which is equivalent to 3.5 billion dollars annually due to the bad lifestyle choices that they have adopted. Stress and sedentary lifestyle have often been regarded as the major contributors to a deteriorating health condition. And this condition does not only remain limited to physical instability but also the overall productivity of an individual. In order to quantify the monetary loss caused by lifestyle-related problems in the IT sector in Bengaluru, a city-based consulting firm carried out a survey across 10 IT firms. According to the study, the 50 million dollar IT hub of Bengaluru is suffering from a performance drop and the professionals are making an effort to bring up their living conditions. Physical inactivity and poor emotional health are the major contributors for 50% of the productivity loss. It has also been found that employees within the age bar of 30-40 are found to count to 42% of productivity loss and those coming under 20-30 years counts to 30% of the productivity loss with poor diet. The respondents who were being surveyed by the Consulting firm were analysed on five different parameters namely- 1. Physical inactivity 2. Emotional and mental health 3. Physical health 4. Improper diet and 5. Substance Abuse These parameters revealed the fact that Physical inactivity sums up to 25% of productivity loss, emotional and mental health leads to 23%, Physical health leads to 21%, poor diet leads to 18% and substance abuse leads to 13% of the productive loss. Encouraging employees to opt for certain physical activities or creating awareness about the same is likely to bring more lifestyle changes in society. It is a win-win situation for both the parties as good health would lead to a more progressive and developed corporate structure. Taking into consideration the contemporary lifestyle issues that lead to obesity and other health problems, Kairali Ayurvedic Group has come up with some natural alternatives to combat the struggling issues. Ayurvedic treatments and therapies to release stress and obesity, Yoga and Meditation for health and wellness and a strict Ayurvedic diet regimen are provided by Kairali to let people understand the need for a healthy mind and body to continue with a long-lasting and fit life. The true essence of Ayurveda can be sensed at Kairali due to which a completely natural and a holistic life can be enjoyed without incurring any loss at a personal as well as at a professional level. http://www.whyayurveda.org/news-and-opinion/2019/01/25/ayurveda-as-a-preventive-measure-to-cut-down-plaguing-lifestyle-issues.aspx Posted By Abhilash K.R posted on Fri 25 Jan 2019 at 03:46 PM Learn More Next →

The pharmaceutical division of Kairali Group has been strengthening the ancient tradition of Ayurveda through continuous Research and Development (R&D) to suit modern life style. First started in 1948 by late K.S. Vasudevan, it has been carried forward by the next generation with continuous improvements within its manufacturing structure and quality. Kairali manufactures patent medicines such as Lipidex, Durance, Duravin Forte, Mulberine, Spalive, Spazyme, Spacol & Sparub which are prescribed by the physician according to the ailments of the patients.

Ayurvedic Oils & Ayurvedic Gulika's

Kairali manufacture Classical Ayurvedic Oils such as Neelibhrumgadi Tailam, Kottamchukadi Tailam etc. & Ayurvedic Gulika's such as Manasamitram Vatikam, Gorochanadi Gulika, Maha Dhanwantharam Gulika etc.

Kairali's Herbal Oils, Cosmetic Products & Herbal Tea

Kairali manufactures patent Herbal Oils such as Kaircin, Karishma, Khayya, Kairkare, Kairoil, Kairtis etc., Cosmetic Products such as Herbal Shampoo's & Soaps and Herbal Tea.

sections.html:
Ayurvedic Hospitality

Hospitality is synonymous to Kerala and Kerala is synonymous to Ayurveda. The Ayurvedic ways and means to achieve a balanced human system of the mind, body and soul can be best cited with Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village.

This royal structure has a 50 acre property surrounded by lush greenery and you will experience a sense of calmness and peace as soon as you set foot on the property. The hospitable and amiable nature of all the staff members makes Kairali a destination, never to be forgotten. The professional therapists and the doctors too are fully dedicated in trying out to help and and every visitor who visits Kairali.

Read more

Ayurvedic Treatment Centres

Kairali Ayurvedic Group, established in the year 1908 have set its benchmark in propagating the essence of Ayurveda.

With its first Ayurvedic Treatment Centre in 1989 in New Delhi, it has not looked back ever since. With the onset of more and more Ayurvedic treatment centres, Kairali have reached the hearts of millions by delivering goodness and authenticity of services. The Ayurvedic treatment centres are a model of genuine healthcare and wellness excellency that cater to the general well-being of all individuals. With extensive and compassionate doctor’s consultation, and also a rejuvenating course of Ayurvedic treatments and therapies, one attains a perfect balance of the human system.

Read more

Ayurvedic Medicines And Remedies

Kairali Ayurvedic Products with the help of its professionals and expert Research & Development (R&D) team, creates new innovations in order to help people fall prey to any ailment.

The medicines and the remedies that Kairali gives are all Ayurvedic in nature which means that the ingredients are all hand-picked from nature. It is then researched and developed as per the need of the ailment. These are in the form of capsules and syrups. Ayurvedic medicines are an alternate form of medicine that enables you to experience the goodness of all the Ayurvedic ingredients found in the lap of nature.

banner.h1: Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village is declared the Winner of Best Luxury Ayurveda Spa for 2020

sections.html:
A transformative practice in Ayurveda

The Ayurvedic healing Village is a haven in total serenity that focusses on the possibly the best relaxation environment. There's also a vast spectrum of traditional therapies offered at the spa, and nothing excites us more than observing visitors overcome lifelong health issues with only a few weeks of advice from our world-class Ayurvedic experts.

We are the best Ayurveda Spa in South West Asia as we have been providing customized therapies and various detoxifying services focused on unique wellness goals like post-pregnancy care, stress management, arthritis, beauty care, migraine and weight management.

We always know that customers have the opportunity to get involved in daily classes in ayurvedic cooking and diet, meditation and yoga throughout their visit. It means that our visitors can extend their lifestyles adjustments even when they come back home.

Modern Védic Wellness

Visitors are allocated villas as per their Astrological signs and experience incredible atmospheres like Red Oxide floor tiles, a unique Valambari Labret coral and a calming lake running around each villa. We have been providing various types of lessons on meditation, Ancient India, yoga courses, and Indian Traditional ceremonies (pujas).

The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the embodiment of Kairali's experience in conceptual elegance – a wonderfully organic architecture born of eternal knowledge. Spending time at this fascinating heaven will leave you questioning whether you're enjoying the height of contemporary integrated elegance, or whether you've drifted deep into the hidden history of India.

Everything seems to have an impression of the natural world. Nature is the prominent resident here, and the result of this existence is calming. It is quite possible to lose yourself nowadays in the beauty of luxury, and unmistakably, nature considers everybody here as infants of its own.

2020 Best Luxury Ayurveda Spa Regional Winner: South West Asia

The Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village is the 2020 Best Luxury Ayurveda Spa Regional Winner: South West Asia. This award is highly recognized international award that honors spa and wellness, hospitality executives. Affirmation is marked high accomplishment by spas around the globe in all of the mentioned categories. A panel of fellow experts selects the winners. A few of the world's most glittering, luxurious sites and locations host these awards.

Visitors dealing with a variety of chronic diseases are given a combination of a healthy lifestyle focused on Ayurveda values, with dietary guidelines that favor various body characteristics depending on the tri dosha and Ayurveda-based oil therapies, mastered through years of practice. Physicians, cooks, meditation experts and yoga teachers work cooperatively at the Kairali the Ayurvedic Healing Village, to enable visitors to cope with the different lifestyle disorders they could be dealing with because of anxiety, overweight and digestive disorders. We have been awarded to be the Best Luxury Ayurveda Spa in South West Asia. It represents the best of holistic practices, the model draws from India's therapeutic history and Ayurveda, with its origins in the Vedic history and cultural Ayurveda spa treatments from Kerala.

Our dedication to spirituality at The Ayurvedic Healing Village reflects the brand's concept of body, mind and soul reinvigoration and it has also helped us to be the Best Ayurveda Spa in South West Asia.

We deliver a variety of services that provide a whole range of treatments taken from Ayurveda, meditation, relaxation, and nutrition. In keeping with seasoned Ayurveda experts who run the spa, our proper induction cuisine is designed. Our retreat is 100% Veg and all ingredients are sourced from our own farm. All our oils and medicines are manufactured in our own unit by following all the health standards.

To Know more about our retreat call us at +91-9555156156

banner.h1: Kairali Hand Sanitizer received the Certificate of Compliance from Safe Cosmetics Australia

sections.html:
Kairali Ayurvedic Group, a 100-year-old Ayurvedic Brand introduces Kairali Hand Sanitizer to ensure personal hygiene. It is an effective and convenient way to clean your dirty and contaminated hands without using soap and water. It effectively kills 99.99% germs and bacteria from hands by leaving a sweet and everlasting fragrance. Kairali hand sanitizer received the Certificate of Compliance for considering the Ingredients first from Safe Cosmetics Australia. Safe Cosmetic Australia is the certifying authority for non- toxic formulations. Safe Cosmetic works to eliminate dangerous chemicals linked to adverse health impacts of Cosmetics and personal care products. It recommends brands that adopt the toxic- free approach to formulating cosmetics without the use of toxic chemicals. Made Safe Certificate (Made with Safe Ingredient) verifies that products are made with ingredients not suspected to harm human health, animals, or ecosystems. It evaluates products through a scientific process.

Kairali Hand sanitizer is a product from Kairali Ayurvedic Products Private Limited (KAPPL), a trusted and well-established name in manufacturing authentic Ayurvedic products and medicines. All these products are manufactured with raw materials that are sourced locally and are environmentally safe. These products are non-toxic and non- evasive and aim towards maintaining and restoring the body’s capabilities to maintain a balance and fight all ailments. Since all these products are made by using herbs and rare plants that are grown under the strict supervision of Kairali’s staff. This ensures that high quality is maintained.

This liquid alcohol hand sanitizer is used to clean and disinfect frequently touched surfaces daily such as phones, keyboards, sinks, light switches, handles, and tables. If surfaces are dirty, clean them using a household disinfectant. It gets dry in seconds by giving a sweet scent and a long-lasting fragrance upon its repetitive use. It fights against bacterial action due to its antibacterial and antimicrobial properties. They contain alcohol that acts as a disinfectant by destroying microorganisms on the hand. The “on the go” pack of Kairali hand sanitizers is easy and convenient to carry in a purse, bags. It is faster, more effective, and better tolerated by your hands than washing with soap and water. These hand sanitizers are also available in bulk packaging options of 5000ml, 50Ltrs, and 250Ltrs to supply to the institutions, offices, schools, and fitness centers. The bulk pack is used to refill the automatic hand sanitizer dispenser. This instant hand sanitizer effectively suppresses or inactivates the growth of bacteria and viruses. It keeps your hand supple and germ-free. It is a good hygiene practice that ensures the protection from bacteria or germs and the proper maintenance of hygiene and sanitation.

For more information about Hand Sanitizers, visithttps://www.kairaliproducts.in/catalogsearch/result/?q=hand+sanitizer or contact us at +91-9555156156 or write to us at support@kairaliproducts.com

• Kairali donates foodgrains to the migrant workers

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group believes in contributing to the greater good of the society. And to this end, the company has made a substantial donation by distributing food grains to migrant workers during this lockdown.

    Founded over a century ago, Kairali Ayurvedic Group has always been synonymous with high quality and best-in-class service. While the founders and the present leaders have always had a firm belief in offering our services to the needy and give back to the society whenever possible, it was in the testing times of Covid-19, that this belief has permeated to all the employees.

    Kairali Ayurvedic Group made a generous donation of food grains to stranded migrants during this lockdown after their plight was noticed by our senior management. While the whole country was reeling under the side-effects of Covid-19 and the lockdown, the migrants and day-to-day labourers were the hardest hit. Right from being unable to get one meal a day to walking back home on empty stomachs, the migrants faced a survival issue, to say the least.

    Keeping true to our sense of righteousness and trying our best to fulfil our commitment towards society as a responsible brand, we decided to donate food grains to minimize their plight. Taking this thought forward, our CSR team took up the task with a determined zeal and chalked out a plan in record time. And soon, we were ready to take action.

    We tied up with other NGOs and local heroes and sheroes, and started donating sacks of food grains to the migrants. We made sure to pack in a healthy bunch of rice, daal and other basic pulses to pack in a nutritious dietary meal for the migrants who were either on their way to their ancestral village or were finding it difficult to survive without day-to-day earnings.

    At the end of our CSR activity thousands of migrants were fed and we had the satisfaction of having been able to contribute towards society in these difficult times. We hope to keep on improving our services and do our best towards holistic societal improvement.

    Want to know more about us? visit www.kairali.com

    Want to know more about products and services? visit www.kairaliproducts.in

  • Quick Chat with Mrs.Gita Ramesh: Give your daily routine "All day Ayurveda" makeover

    Mrs. Gita Ramesh discusses with Beauty Launchpad India about the Ayurveda, the oldest scientific medical system and adaptation of Ayurveda style in daily regimen

    Mrs. Gita Ramesh, the Joint Managing Director of Kairali Ayurvedic Group interacted with Beauty Launchpad India about Ayurveda System & Urban Health Exigencies. She explained Ayurveda as a preventive theory which is the oldest scientific medical system that means “Science of life.” This 5000-year-old tradition system called Holistic science that is still considered to be beneficial and relevant to modern life. Nowadays, people are acknowledging the authentic ways of life through Ayurveda and adapting to natural ways of living. Kairali- The Ayurvedic Healing Village also called a ‘Green Retreat’ that has never failed to fascinate and attract guests with its authentic treatments and therapies on the basis of Ayurvedic traditions and principles. A normal day begins at the retreat with Yoga and meditation that helps one get a better understanding of the body type that is considered very essential for maintaining proper health.

    Beliefs and Ideologies of Authentic Ayurveda

    The common basic idea of medicine and philosophy is that every human being is a unique phenomenon of the universe, expressed through five basic elements of Mother Nature – Earth, Air, Water, Fire, and Space. As per Ayurveda, three primary life forces exist in the body system – Vata, Pitta, and Kapha. Everybody's constitution has a unique balance of Vata, Pitta, and Kapha as per nature. Perfect equilibrium in between these vital forces results in a healthy state of body thereby balances the mind, body, and soul. When the doshic balance imbalances, it results in a disorder.

    Ayurvedic physician diagnoses and establish the cause of imbalance in the body system which can be due to an increase or decrease in the vital forces, after which the physician prescribes the treatment and therapy to bring back the doshas to be balanced. The main objective of Ayurveda is to focus on preventive measures.     Bengaluru, specifically known to be the IT hub of India is recently found out to lose its productivity due to various unhealthy lifestyle issues. These lifestyle issues in the IT sector should be curbed and improved to make it possible for the companies as well as employees to grow. Kairali makes an attempt through Ayurveda to make lives better and productive.

    Health that needs to be replaced with 'Good Health'

    We all know how our lives are becoming stressful day by day. Each and every activity of ours is making us prone to various health issues that need serious attention and care. A piece of recent news by WION has given the world some shocking results relating to the loss of productivity that has hit the IT sector. We are quite aware of the fact that stress and other unwanted pressures are harmful to the body. Yet we procrastinate our daily requirements and continue to lead a life amidst chaos and confusion.

    A news clip on WION News had taken India through a reality check wherein it has shown how the IT sector in Bengaluru is leading to a huge productivity loss and when these statistics were revealed in terms of quantity, everyone was blown away. It revealed that the IT sector is losing 24,000 crores which is equivalent to 3.5 billion dollars annually due to the bad lifestyle choices that they have adopted. Stress and sedentary lifestyle have often been regarded as the major contributors to a deteriorating health condition. And this condition does not only remain limited to physical instability but also the overall productivity of an individual.

    In order to quantify the monetary loss caused by lifestyle-related problems in the IT sector in Bengaluru, a city-based consulting firm carried out a survey across 10 IT firms. According to the study, the 50 million dollar IT hub of Bengaluru is suffering from a performance drop and the professionals are making an effort to bring up their living conditions. Physical inactivity and poor emotional health are the major contributors for 50% of the productivity loss. It has also been found that employees within the age bar of 30-40 are found to count to 42% of productivity loss and those coming under 20-30 years counts to 30% of the productivity loss with poor diet.

    The respondents who were being surveyed by the Consulting firm were analysed on five different parameters namely-

    1. Physical inactivity

    2. Emotional and mental health

    3. Physical health

    4. Improper diet and

    5. Substance Abuse

    These parameters revealed the fact that Physical inactivity sums up to 25% of productivity loss, emotional and mental health leads to 23%, Physical health leads to 21%, poor diet leads to 18% and substance abuse leads to 13% of the productive loss. Encouraging employees to opt for certain physical activities or creating awareness about the same is likely to bring more lifestyle changes in society. It is a win-win situation for both the parties as good health would lead to a more progressive and developed corporate structure.

    Taking into consideration the contemporary lifestyle issues that lead to obesity and other health problems, Kairali Ayurvedic Group has come up with some natural alternatives to combat the struggling issues. Ayurvedic treatments and therapies to release stress and obesity, Yoga and Meditation for health and wellness and a strict Ayurvedic diet regimen are provided by Kairali to let people understand the need for a healthy mind and body to continue with a long-lasting and fit life. The true essence of Ayurveda can be sensed at Kairali due to which a completely natural and a holistic life can be enjoyed without incurring any loss at a personal as well as at a professional level.

Improper diet and 5.
